questions.question: Does the GDT735 historical evidence support only coexistence of descriptive learned wholes and prescriptive bound fields while leaving all 24 PULVIS/SEMEN/RADIX/LIGNUM-to-H1-H4 assignments observationally tied?
questions.unit_and_scope: The historical two-channel architecture and the opaque H1-H4 grid; no EVA initial, body gloss, component export or four-head word mapping.
questions.actual_tested_falsifier: GDT735 enumerated all 4! = 24 assignments and found every assignment explains the same 96 structural cells (METHOD lines 38-45). It separately found no interchangeable four-head one-letter material code in the 22-source registry (METHOD lines 61-67). The mixed prior would be demoted if the historical observations failed to instantiate separable channels or if MS.542 lacked either direct channel (PREREGISTRATION lines 38-45).
questions.future_distinct_outcome: A genuinely new primary historical source that directly identifies an interchangeable four-head code, or that collapses the descriptive/prescriptive channel distinction, would change the historical architecture decision. Another OCR rank, head-frequency association, or permutation score would leave the 24-way nonidentifiability unchanged.

questions.question: After GDT737's held-body transfer, which part of GDT736 remains admissible: the H1/H2 versus H3/H4 record-location axis, while the frozen H1-H4/H2-H3 body-affinity pair ranking is rejected?
questions.unit_and_scope: H1-H4 opaque head classes over the 120 held shared bodies, distinguishing occurrence-conditioned record location from the failed body-affinity 2x2. No head or body lexeme claim.
questions.actual_tested_falsifier: GDT737's preregistered primary falsifier required H1-H4 and H2-H3 to remain the two strongest raw-count cosine pairs; on the held panel H1-H4 ranked 3rd/4th and H2-H3 was ain-dominated (REPORT lines 14-29). In contrast, H1/H2 remained earlier and more paragraph-first than H3/H4 (REPORT lines 7-12). The body-affinity failure is therefore known and must not be reopened by more same-route body counts.
questions.future_distinct_outcome: A genuinely different occurrence-gated exact-neighbor-frame analysis could test whether the surviving location roles predict independently defined local record relations. It would change the structural-role decision only if its predeclared location contrast separates from an occurrence/order null; it cannot resurrect the failed body-affinity pair ranking.

# GDT737 design fix

The target is the 120 shared remainders in GDT635 that were not among the 24
complete four-head bodies used by GDT736. No new page, image, transcription or
meaning source is admitted.

The primary transfer checks are inherited rather than tuned to this panel:

1. H1/H2 should remain earlier and more often line-first than H3/H4.
2. H1 should remain more often paragraph-first than H2.
3. H3 should remain later or more often final than H4.
4. The frozen GDT736 body-affinity claim passes only if H1-H4 and H2-H3 remain
   the two strongest raw occurrence-count cosine pairs across held bodies.

Reader-exact, occupancy, section, body-balanced and binary-presence views are
diagnostics. They may explain a primary result but may not replace the frozen
raw-count test.
